_doc: Master alarm database of LINE01 (ISA-18.2 rationalization) for the alarms service (services/alarms, ADR-0026). Codes and texts of source PLC01 mirror the PLC alarm table godot/control/sorting_line/line_alarms.gd (checked by services/alarms/tests); source MAINTENANCE: advisory alarms of the maintenance service (alarm word on the UNS topic maintenance.alarm_topic, ADR-0029); priority from the PLC reaction and the consequence (ABORT/E-stop -> Critical/High, HOLD -> High/Medium, warning -> Low). suppressed_by: alarms that are consequences of another active alarm are suppressed by design (recorded, not annunciated). suppress_in_states: PackML states (packml_state) in which the alarm is suppressed by design. Reference: docs/interfaces/services.md#alarms.

alarms.text_en: E-stop pressed: release it, then Clear and Reset
alarms.text_de: Not-Halt betätigt: entriegeln, dann Quittieren (Clear) und Zurücksetzen (Reset)
alarms.consequence_en: Line aborted, robot stopped by the safety circuit
alarms.remedy_en: Remove the cause, release the E-stop button (twist), then Clear and Reset the line
alarms.remedy_de: Ursache beseitigen, Not-Halt-Taster entriegeln (drehen), dann Clear und Reset

alarms.consequence_en: Line aborted, no transport to the inspection
alarms.remedy_en: Check the drive (VFD) of CV01, reset the fault, then Clear and Reset the line
alarms.remedy_de: Antrieb (Frequenzumrichter) von CV01 prüfen, Störung zurücksetzen, dann Clear und Reset

alarms.remedy_en: Clear the robot fault on the teach pendant, then Unhold
alarms.remedy_de: Roboterstörung am Bediengerät beheben, dann Unhold

alarms.text_en: RB01 protective stop (safety fence door open)
alarms.consequence_en: Line held until the door is closed
alarms.remedy_en: Leave the cell and close the fence door; the line resumes automatically
alarms.remedy_de: Zelle verlassen und Schutzzauntür schließen; die Linie läuft automatisch weiter

alarms.text_en: LB02 inspection light barrier blocked (signal stuck)
alarms.consequence_en: Line held, parts are not positioned for the inspection
alarms.remedy_en: Remove an obstruction, clean and align LB02
alarms.remedy_de: Hindernis entfernen, LB02 reinigen und ausrichten

alarms.text_en: LB01 infeed light barrier blocked (signal stuck)
alarms.consequence_en: Line held, infeed tracking not possible
alarms.remedy_en: Remove an obstruction, clean and align LB01
alarms.remedy_de: Hindernis entfernen, LB01 reinigen und ausrichten

alarms.text_en: Infeed timeout: released part not seen at LB01
alarms.text_de: Einlauf-Timeout: freigegebenes Teil nicht an LB01 erkannt
alarms.consequence_en: Serial number assignment of the part may be lost
alarms.remedy_en: Check the transfer point AC01/CV01 and the alignment of LB01; remove misplaced parts
alarms.remedy_de: Übergabestelle AC01/CV01 und Ausrichtung von LB01 prüfen; verlegte Teile entfernen

alarms.text_en: GR01 gripper fingers worn: remaining useful life below the threshold, maintenance order open
alarms.text_de: GR01 Greiferfinger verschlissen: Restnutzungsdauer unter der Schwelle, Instandhaltungsauftrag offen
alarms.consequence_en: Parts slip and the robot faults (alarm 202) if the fingers are not replaced in time
alarms.remedy_en: Plan the maintenance order on the MES terminal (Tasklist); the fingers are replaced at the next order boundary
alarms.remedy_de: Instandhaltungsauftrag am MES-Terminal (Tasklist) einplanen; die Finger werden an der nächsten Auftragsgrenze getauscht
